# Mayo TV: what the app really runs on a TV box, start-up first (S), hot (H), after start-up (P).
#
# Recorded on a Nokia Streaming Box 8010 (Android 14) from v1.0.341 in everyday use: cold starts, Home,
# Live TV with zapping, Sports. `cmd package dump-profiles` on the profileable release build, names
# turned back through that build's R8 mapping (tools in the improvement loop: profdeobf.py). Unlike
# mayo-tv-app.txt it also covers the libraries' paths this app takes (coroutines, Coil, OkHttp, Compose),
# which ran interpreted after every update until the box's background dexopt caught up: the first cold
# start after an update measured ~1950 ms against ~1730 ms once recompiled from use.
